svg.title: Bleeding in early pregnancy: ultrasound read against beta-hCG decides whether the pregnancy is in the uterus and viable, sorting it into threatened, open-cervix or missed miscarriage, molar pregnancy, pregnancy of unknown location or ectopic; each column gives presentation, numbered investigations and treatment in order
